label: sk-vision dist gap is real at plugin load: .opencode/plugins/sk-vision.js is a tracked symlink (git mode 120000) pointing at ../skills/sk-vision/vision-runtime/dist/plugin.js, which is never built or shipped (dist absent in worktree and clone, not gitignored). Loading the plugin fails ENOENT until bun install && bun run build. Not on README steps 1-3; hit when sk-vision is used.

The 'sk-vision tests failing until vision-runtime/dist is built' claim is not supported: tests import src and python/runtime.test.ts spawns python/runtime.py (source) with interpreter fallback ~/.cache/sk-vision/venv -> repo .venv -> python3; no test references dist. Residual uncertainty: no bun test bake-off was executed this iteration.

The compiled-routing rebuild dependence on specs/sk-doc/z_archive is real but ships with the clone: AUTHORED_PROGRAM_DIR is hardcoded (layout.cjs:53-55); sync, guard and the pre-commit route-remint gate read it; the 6996-file z_archive tree including the exact path is tracked and present in the fresh clone. Cost is fragility if that tree is moved or deleted, not a current newcomer stumble.

Hook trust is code-enforced: an untrusted checkout (foreign git common dir, no local skilled.trustRepoHooks=true) sets SOURCE_ROOT=.skilled-untrusted, skips all pre-commit gates, and prints only a stderr NOTICE with the enable command; the requirement is prose in README Git Hooks, not a numbered install step. First clone is trusted by construction; a second clone or moved checkout silently degrades.

Worktree provisioning is not on the first-packet path: README install steps create no worktree; sk-git makes the worktree-vs-branch question mandatory only when git-workspace work begins; the launch wrapper is operator opt-in and documents a wholesale-symlink isolation gap. Cost is a deferred mandatory choice (confused), not a first-packet block.

Further stumbles: (a) sk-vision requires Bun (engines.bun >=1.0.0; bun run/build scripts) but README never mentions bun; (b) first sk-vision model load needs ~3.9 GB of weights, uv/venv provisioning, and Apple Silicon or Ampere+ GPU, documented only inside the skill; (c) SKILL.md:208 names a nonexistent .skilled/plugins/sk-vision.js path; (d) 36 empty tracked .skilled_skills_* files at the repo root remain unexplained.

Provisional ranked fix set (Q5): F1 delete README:162 auto-build falsehood; F2 add Code Mode Node 24.x to README prerequisites; F3 document sk-vision Bun + bun install/build setup; F4 move hook-trust command into numbered install steps; F5 add step-3-requires-step-2 clause; F6 optional removal of 36 empty clutter files. No fix earned for the z_archive dependence (sources ship in the clone). Each fix records its move and climbing sentence under prevent-overengineering.
